items.title: 現在のエコー インベントリの制限が 3000 件であることに不満を抱いている人がいるかわかりません。
items.sourceType: 海外Redditフォーラム 鳴潮総合 (公式純リンクRSS)
items.scriptOutline:
【動画・記事の完全論説・網羅的詳細】：
Every now and then I still see someone talking about how they're approaching the echo inventory limit and stuff like that, and I genuinely don't get how does one even reach it? Even if you tried to build a unique set for every single character released so far (and that's assuming that you have ALL the characters), it still wouldn't be enough to even reach a quarter of the current limit 80% of the 3-cost echoes obtained are useless on the character you're building (unless you've got a ton-shit of modifiers), hoarding echoes just makes no sense when the recycling feature is right there and takes about 30 seconds to do so, all resonators nowadays have their own personal sonata set, so there's really no need to keep collecting echoes of one specific character when you've already finished building them (unless you're some hardcore min-maxer) I feel like any issues that come with the current echo inventory limit are purely self-imposed, and it should only be something to actually complain about once we get somewhere around, idk, 200 playable resonators?    submitted by    /u/m_studio_x   [link]   [個のコメント]

items.title: 【鳴潮】水着＆夏衣装スキンモデル全網羅！デザイン美とビジュアル評価

items.title: 【鳴潮】通常衣装と新衣装（夏服）における「お菓子のしまい方」の細かすぎる違い

items.title: 【鳴潮】「むすー」とした表情（不機嫌顔）が可愛すぎるキャラたち集落

items.title: 【鳴潮】開発元Kuro Games（クロゲ）のキャラクターデザインが最高すぎる理由
